provenance.giver: Universal Dependencies — UD_English-EWT (train split), human-annotated gold treebank
provenance.basis: a form's UPOS distribution CONDITIONED on the dominant class of the following token — the observable trace of the construction, since HEAD/DEPREL are a parse and unavailable when reading raw prose
provenance.dropped: the source carries LEMMA, XPOS, FEATS, HEAD, DEPREL, DEPS, MISC per token; this output keeps none of them — in particular HEAD/DEPREL (the parse) and FEATS (e.g. VerbForm=Part) are cut here, and any downstream absence of them is this cut, not the treebank's ignorance (READING-SPEC S10)

declared.scope: ambiguous forms only — a form the treebank tags with one class has no superposition to collapse
declared.backoff: consult form|nextClass; short of the floor, fall back to the form-level POSPrior@1; short of that, a typed gap — never a guess
